items.title: Ubisoft games aren't "required to use generative AI," Assassin's Creed publisher says after reports emerge that devs have to justify not using it in pitches
items.excerpt: Ubisoft issued a formal statement saying its teams are encouraged to explore generative AI but are not required to use it, responding to a report that pitches must justify not using the tools.

items.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby AI clone laden with ads taken off mobile platforms after fans report it en masse to Cygames
items.excerpt: An ad-stuffed AI-generated knockoff of Umamusume: Pretty Derby, 'Anime Racing Academy', was struck off mobile storefronts after fans mass-reported it to Cygames.

items.title: Fed up of Steam's lack of action regarding AI slop? Maybe you should take a look at the 'Games Without AI' event, instead
items.excerpt: A third-party 'Games Without AI' showcase on Steam features around 96 titles whose developers attest they were made without generative AI, after criticism of AI slop in Next Fest.

items.title: We are already in a world where gen-AI is pushing people to promote games as human-made, Citizen Sleeper creator says
items.excerpt: Citizen Sleeper creator Gareth Damian Martin says gen-AI adoption is spreading so widely that games will start marketing themselves as human-made.

items.title: Another Modder Uses AI to Make a Multiplayer Mode for The Last of Us Part 2, Insists There Isn't Much Sony Can Do About It 'Even if They Do Shut Me Down'
items.excerpt: A modder says they used AI tools to build a multiplayer mode for The Last of Us Part 2 and argues Sony can do little to stop AI-assisted mods even with takedowns.

items.title: Modder behind AI-powered The Last of Us 2 multiplayer project says "there ain't much" Sony can do, "even if they do shut me down"
items.excerpt: Same story as IGN: the modder behind an AI-built TLOU2 multiplayer project says AI tooling means takedowns can't put 'Pandora's box' back.

items.title: 『Slay the Spire 2』の超難関アセンション10を「80％クリアできるAI」が誕生。142億回の決断と“先読み”で、猛者の領域に
items.excerpt: A research paper proposes AlphaDefect, a reinforcement-learning system trained on 14.2 billion decisions that clears Slay the Spire 2's hardest Ascension 10 about 80% of the time.

items.title: 크래프톤, 독자 개발 고효율 LLM '라온-1 미니' 정식 출시
items.excerpt: Krafton released the official version of Raon-1 mini, a from-scratch 30B MoE LLM (4B active) with in-house linear attention, after an October preview.

items.title: 크래프톤·시프트업이 만든 AI, 성적표로 말하다
items.excerpt: Roundup: Krafton's Raon-1 mini launch plus Shift Up's COZY translation system placing in the top group at WMT 2026 against Amazon, Samsung and Huawei.

items.title: 시프트업, 국제 기계번역 대회 WMT 2026에서 최상위 그룹 선정
items.excerpt: Shift Up's in-house AI translation system COZY was placed in the frontier group of WMT 2026's terminology translation track; the studio applies it to game localization.

items.title: 今年の韓国最大級ゲームショウのメインスポンサーはAIキャラクターチャットの「Crack」。日本版「キャラぷ」を運営する日本法人代表に，クリエイター還元の仕組みや会話の中身を原則見ない運営を聞く［G-STAR 2026］
items.excerpt: Interview with the head of the Japanese arm of AI character-chat service Crack, G-STAR 2026's first non-game main sponsor, on creator revenue sharing and its policy of not reading conversations.

items.title: Ludo.ai launches AI Tileset Generator for 2D games
items.excerpt: Ludo.ai's Tileset Generator builds 16-tile terrain and line sets for 2D games from a ground description, with top-down and isometric grids, browser testing and engine exports.

items.title: Unity Asset Store and CLI: Let Your AI Agent Find and Add Assets
items.excerpt: Unity CLI now lets coding agents search the Asset Store, pull single prefabs from packs and generate missing assets with 60+ AI models; a new Asset Library plugin finds assets from plain-language descriptions (open beta).

items.title: Instead of just describing where things go, you can annotate (draw, select, point) in the scene - Unity Spark Annotate
items.excerpt: Unity shows Annotate in Unity Spark: draw, select or point directly on the game scene to give the AI exact visual context instead of describing placement in text; closed-beta waitlist open.

items.title: AI 캐디와 대화하며 즐기는 스크린 골프...프라임파크골프 출시
items.excerpt: Primepark Dome launched Primepark Golf, a screen-golf system with a voice-conversational AI caddy that greets players by name and answers distance/green-slope requests.

items.title: Q&A: How Everstone Brings Where Winds Meet to Life with NVIDIA DLSS 5
items.excerpt: Everstone Studio explains how it integrated DLSS 5 neural rendering into Where Winds Meet for more realistic lighting and materials across landscapes and characters.

items.title: Ludo.ai launches AI-powered Tileset Generator for 2D game development
items.excerpt: Off-list alt for the Ludo.ai Tileset Generator story (same event as Mobidictum).
